title: Exceptional dining experience in Sevilla
text:
Great experience-5 star. A privilege to be hosted by Chef Elena in her home.
Historic building. 7 course meal and wine pairings. Personalized service. A must do in Sevilla! 
A very special experience in Sevilla

title: Highly recommend!!
text: Absolutely amazing meal! Maria is the real deal. And while the food was wonderful the experience was better. Thank you!!

title: An Evening at Villa Elena — A Culinary Memory Etched in the Heart
text:

title: EXTRAORDINARY GASTRONOMIC EXPERIENCE. REFERENCE PLACE TO REPEAT.
text:
Extraordinary dining experience.
Unique and very cozy house where you feel like yours.
The hostess, Elena, is a very special chef, "who knows how to cook for real" and who takes care of every detail with a pampering and dedication rarely found in the hospitality.
The result is a go-to place for business/work meetings, highly recommended for privacy, excellent menu, original high quality wine list and careful service.
Oh... and an exclusive terrace where you can have a premium drink, which you must not miss.
We'll definitely be back.
author: J1546PPmariod
